name: Payment Condition Status 2
definition: Specifies the details on the status of the payment conditions.

AcceptedAmount.name: Accepted Amount
AcceptedAmount.definition: Amount accepted to be paid.||Usage:|May only be present when AmountModificationAllowed is present in the request.

GuaranteedPayment.name: Guaranteed Payment
GuaranteedPayment.definition: Indicates if the DebtorAgent guarantees the payment, assuming a payment guarantee contract exists between the different actors.||Usage: When element is not present, the default value is "Not Applicable".

EarlyPayment.name: Early Payment
EarlyPayment.definition: Indicates if the debtor will pay before the requested execution date.||Usage: When element is not present, the default value is "Not Applicable".
